<|end|><|start|>assistant<|channel|>analysis to=python code<|message|>def f_bruteforce(n, limit=1000):
    # find smallest X up to limit such that there exist three distinct positive divisors summing to n
    for X in range(1, limit+1):
        divs = [d for d in range(1, X+1) if X % d == 0]
        # pick three distinct divisors
        for i in range(len(divs)):
            for j in range(i+1, len(divs)):
                for k in range(j+1, len(divs)):
                    if divs[i] + divs[j] + divs[k] == n:
                        return X
    return None

def f_formula(n):
    N = n - 1
    # find smallest divisor >2 of N
    # smallest divisor >2 may be composite but minimal prime factor >2
    # We'll find smallest divisor d>2 dividing N
    for d in range(3, N+1):
        if N % d == 0:
            return N - N//d
    return None

for n in range(6, 31):
    fb = f_bruteforce(n, limit=2000)
    ff = f_formula(n)
    print(n, fb, ff, fb==ff)
